subject: general
question: Who among the following was awarded the Sansad Ratna Award 2023 and represents the Indian National Congress in Lok Sabha from West Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury**, a senior leader of the Indian National Congress, represents the **Baharampur constituency in West Bengal** in the Lok Sabha.
 
• He was awarded the **Sansad Ratna Award 2023**, which recognizes outstanding parliamentarians for their exemplary performance in legislative work.
 
• Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury has been a prominent figure in Indian politics, serving as the **Leader of the Opposition in Lok Sabha** for the INC.
 
• The Sansad Ratna Awards, instituted by Prime Point Foundation, focus on evaluating MPs based on their work, such as debates, questions raised, private member bills, and attendance.
 
• Chowdhury's contributions in debates and discussions on critical issues earned him this prestigious recognition in 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sansad Ratna Awards**

 
 
• These awards were introduced in 2010 and are based on data from the Indian Parliament's performance records.
 
• The awards aim to motivate parliamentarians to perform their legislative duties effectively.
 
• Only sitting MPs from the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha are eligible for these awards.
 
• The selection process is conducted by an independent jury panel comprising senior parliamentarians and experts.
 
 
 
• **Indian National Congress (INC)**
 
 
• Founded in 1885, it is one of the oldest political parties in India.
 
• The INC played a pivotal role in India's struggle for independence and was led by iconic leaders like Mahatma Gandhi and Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• Post-independence, the INC has governed India for several decades and continues to be a major political party.
 
 
 
• **Lok Sabha**
 
 
• It is the lower house of the Indian Parliament, consisting of representatives directly elected by the people.
 
• The Lok Sabha is responsible for legislative functions, including law-making and budget approvals.
 
• Members of the Lok Sabha are elected for a term of five years.
 
 
 
• **Leader of Opposition**
 
 
• The Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha is the principal spokesperson of the opposition parties.
 
• They play a critical role in upholding the democratic process by challenging and scrutinizing the policies of the ruling government.
 
• The position is officially recognized if the opposition party has at least 10% of the total seats in Lok Sabha.
